scope: Performance diagnostics only; probes do not establish native acceptance.
notes: Restored HTML and both engine reference PNG hashes exactly match historical c12. The recovered response-cache directory fingerprint differs; no fixture-change saving is credited.
Baseline acceptance attempt stopped at first Brave abnormal watchdog exit; both counts and failure are retained. Two separate cleanup diagnostics exit zero after capture counters are frozen.
Headless CSS probes use 24 distinct recovered stylesheet paths (7656 top-level rules); earlier summaries saying 37 sheets were inaccurate.
Host contention is high and concurrent build/probe jobs are recorded. Sample profiles provide diagnostics, not instruction acceptance.

Rejected candidates include raw deferred-source preprocessing, ordinary subject index, larger inline-cache capacity, absent-class has filter, external containing-block topology cache, retained rare-data sharing, and the initial atomic-inline candidates. Their observations remain here.

Additional rejected candidates: full atomic-inline geometry reuse (including intrinsic queries), and longhand reuse for root calculations/color schemes/clip rectangles. Ordinary token boxing is an additional measured parser candidate.
